params.actualCost: ETH (in wei) actually consumed — must be <= deposit

params.agentOperator: Address that will receive payment on completion
params.taskId: Unique identifier (e.g. keccak256 of a UUID)

cancelTask(bytes32).notice: Cancel a pending task and return full deposit to user.         Can be called by the user or an operator.

completeTask(bytes32,uint256).notice: Operator settles task: deducts actualCost, refunds remainder to user.

depositForTask(bytes32,address).notice: User deposits ETH to start a task. taskId is generated off-chain (keccak of uuid).

markExecuting(bytes32).notice: Operator marks task as executing (optional, for UX tracking).
